Music concerts featuring Nigerian and international stars, fashion exhibitions, cultural festivals and beach parties are among activities lined up across Lagos for the 2026 festive season. The Lagos State Government has released its December entertainment calendar, listing more than 30 events scheduled to take place between December 1 and 31, as the state prepares for the annual Detty December festivities. The programme includes performances by Wizkid, Asake, Lauryn Hill, Brandy, Summer Walker, Young Thug, Kaytranada, BNXN, Adekunle Gold, Seyi Vibez, Ruger, Oxlade and other artistes. The calendar also features the Aso-Oke Festival, African Fashion Week, Lagos Biennial, Street Souk, Made in Nigeria Exhibition, Diaspora Fest 3.0 and the Greater Lagos Countdown, among other activities. According to a statement by the Lagos state government on Saturday the Commissioner for Tourism, Arts and Culture, Toke Benson-Awoyinka, announced the programme, saying the state expected residents, Nigerians living abroad and foreign tourists to participate in the festivities. Randle Centre, The Oasis Ground, Ilashe Beach, Orange Island and Detty December Village. The government said preparations were ongoing to ensure security, traffic management and hospitality arrangements throughout the festive period. The commissioner said Lagos would also offer shopping, dining, beaches, cultural sites, arts, fashion and other attractions to visitors throughout the month. She urged event organisers and residents to cooperate with the government on safety and traffic arrangements to ensure a peaceful festive season. The December programme is part of the government’s efforts to position Lagos as a major tourism and entertainment destination.
